title: Trombonist Yank Johnson
summary: Asked about the band at the Alamo, Guesnon names trombonist Yank Johnson, whom he once confused with Yank Robinson, and praises his sweet tone.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You were telling us about the band of the Alamo, who else was in there? Had the trombone player?

Oh yeah, the trombone player was Yank Johnson. Oh, he was very good. I mean, I kept having his name confused. I used to call him Yank Robinson all the time until I found out that he was Yank Johnson. Now here was a guy who played one of the sweetest trombones.
